summary: Transocean Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing that subsidiary Transocean International Limited entered an amended and restated credit agreement with Citibank as administrative and collateral agent, effective only upon closing of Transocean's previously announced acquisition of Valaris Limited. Terms: revolving commitments rise to $750 million from $510 million, maturity extends from June 2028 to October 2031, covenants modified, facility guaranteed by Transocean and secured by drilling rigs. Lenders' commitments auto-terminate if conditions unmet by May 9, 2027. Separately, Transocean retired $165 million 8.00% Aquila Notes due 2028 on October 1, 2026, saving roughly $22 million interest.
